action.description: rename: set title, or omit title to retitle from the first message. configure: model and effort. handoff: move it to a new Git worktree on branch. interrupt: stop its current turn and its children. settle: move it to Settled, as the person's Settle does; a thread still working (this one, mid-turn) settles when it is done, unless it fails or needs the person. unsettle: bring it back and cancel a pending settle. snooze: mute its notifications until a time. close_preview: stop a preview server. rename_project: rename this project.

onlyIfProvisional.description: rename: only replace a title ace generated, never one the person chose.

requestId.description: Any stable id you choose (letters, digits, _ . -). Repeating a call with the same id does nothing twice.

threadId.description: A thread you own, or with full access any of the person's. Default: this thread.

until.description: snooze: epoch milliseconds, or null to unmute.

x-ace-constraint: configure needs requestId and model; interrupt needs requestId; handoff needs requestId and branch; snooze needs until; close_preview needs previewId; rename_project needs name.
